_readme: Complaint topics no compiled plan covers (ADR-020). Embedded by scripts/compile_plans.py as cache rows that map to no plan: a query nearer to one of these than to any plan's seeds is out of scope, however similar it is to a plan in absolute terms. All 11 plans are Display, while PDF section 3 names Battery, Camera and Performance too, so those three dominate. Written as generic topic statements. The held-out evaluation sets in tests/fixtures/test_*.json are separate complaints, never read by the build; topics such as the keyboard, Always On Display and the vibration motor are deliberately left out here so the evaluation also measures complaints no anchor covers.
anchors: phone runs slowly and apps take long to open
photos are blurry or out of focus
wifi disconnects or will not connect
bluetooth device will not pair or keeps disconnecting
no signal or cannot make calls
nfc or tap to pay is not working
microphone is not working on calls
call audio is muffled or crackling
